description:
Perform a Dynamic Panel Data estimation using the Arellano-Bond estimator. 

1. Download the 'abdata.gdt' dataset from 'http://gretl.sourceforge.net/gretl_data/data/abdata.gdt' and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_data/abdata.gdt'.
2. Create a Gretl hansl script named 'dynamic_panel.inp' in '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/' that:
   - Opens the dataset.
   - Estimates a one-step Arellano-Bond model (using the 'dpanel' command) for the dependent variable 'n' (log employment) with regressors: const, n(-1), w, k, and ys.
   - Saves the full estimation output to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/dpanel_results.txt'.
   - Extracts the p-value of the test for AR(2) errors (second-order autocorrelation) and saves it to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/ar2_pvalue.txt'.
3. Execute the script.
